arcade.title: Code Crush
arcade.lede: Match three coding orbs. Clear cascades, earn XP, climb the monthly ranks, and compete for prizes.
arcade.hintPick: Drag an orb onto a neighbor to swap.
arcade.hintSwap: Keep dragging toward an adjacent orb.
arcade.roundOver: Out of moves - start another round.
arcade.yourRankUnrankedHint: Play a round to enter the tournament and compete for prizes!
arcade.inPrizeZone: 🔥 You're in the top 3! In line for the grand prize!
arcade.inTop10: ⭐ You're in the Top 10! Close to the podium!
arcade.leaderboardSubtitle: Play, score big each month, and win prizes!
arcade.noScoresYet: Be the first to set a high score this month!
arcade.prizesSubtitle: At the end of each calendar month, top players earn exclusive rewards:
arcade.prize1Reward: 1 Month Full Course or 1:1 Live Lesson + "Code Champion" Badge + 500 XP
arcade.prize2Reward: Free 1:1 Live Lesson + "Arcade Master" Badge + 300 XP
arcade.prize3Reward: Exclusive Discord VIP Role + "Top Scorer" Badge + 200 XP
arcade.rulesText: Play Code Crush, improve your score, and maintain a top position. At 23:59 on the last day of each month, rankings freeze and prizes are automatically distributed to winners!
